note: Frames for the luận cung chapters (prose/luan.ts, prose-style plan S2–S4): the palace frame sentence, bold topic lead-ins, the tail of each argued paragraph (synthesis, advice, the two-edged image), Thân cư, the cung giáp / nhị hợp / lục hại positions, hậu vận and the closing. Frames name chart facts and reasoning steps only; every claim still comes from a fired rule of the palace's ReadingPlan, and the tail sentences only juxtapose what the paragraph already said (basis he_thong). Slots: {pal} palace, {branch}, {majors} the palace's chính tinh named with brightness, {star} a star named with brightness, {from} where it shines from, {group}/{note} a Khảo Luận star group, {pair} a giáp pair, {S} the person, {a}/{b} noun phrases said in the paragraph, {seat} the star they come from, {mature} a card's 'mature' clause, {domain} a palace's domain (KL pp.233-236), {config} a palace's stars. Status draft until reviewed.
